# coreapp-v1_cluster_sim_link (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) name of the ClusterSimLink

### Optional

- `hash` (String) resource content will be returned as it was at the time of this git hash

### Read-Only

- `alarms` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alarms))
- `api_version` (String)
- `deviations` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deviations))
- `kind` (String)
- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) ClusterSimLinkSpec defines the desired state of ClusterSimLink.
ClusterSimLink represents a logical sim link between SimNodes that may reside in different namespaces.
All members on one side of the sim link must be in the same namespace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))
- `status` (Attributes) ClusterSimLinkStatus defines the observed state of ClusterSimLink. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Read-Only:

- `bond_name` (String) When creating a ClusterSimLink with more than one member, the bondName is
used to create a bond on the Remote side. This field must not be used when
creating a single-member ClusterSimLink.
- `links` (Attributes List) Define the set of physical sim links making up this ClusterSimLink.
All local endpoints across members must share the same namespace, and all remote endpoints must share the same namespace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--links))

<a id="nestedatt--spec--links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.links`

Read-Only:

- `local` (Attributes) Local, or "A" endpoint of the sim link. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--links--local))
- `remote` (Attributes) Remote, or "B" endpoint of the sim link. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--links--remote))
- `speed` (String) Speed of the sim link.
